# Arcanum

> Arcanum is a life diary app: an archetype test, daily entries with mood tracking, analysis of patterns in the entries, eight personal metrics, a book about the user that gains a page for every week of the diary, plus a daily tarot card and tarot spreads for reflection. It does not offer astrology or predictions.

Made by VO Digital, a sole proprietorship registered in Kazakhstan. The app is for iOS and Android and is not yet available on the App Store or Google Play; this site is a pre-launch landing page.

## Pages

- [Privacy Policy](https://arcanum.garden/privacy/): what data the app processes, in English and Russian.
- [Terms of Use](https://arcanum.garden/terms/): terms governing use of the app.
